tokens.text: A timeline shared by editors and agents
The agent does the rough cut and captions first
Then hands off to Final Cut Pro
A three-minute interview takes about two hours
Sixty percent of it is finding repeated lines
We want the agent to take that part
So people only make the calls
Delete a line and its caption goes too
Brand names like zsir-cut must be right
Numbers like October 2026 must be right
We use Qwen3 for local recognition
With Volcano Engine as cloud fallback
Every cut must be frame accurate
Each cut point accurate to the frame
Check the loss report before handoff
What survives and what must be redone
The editor can keep editing the project
